agents.name: fraud_monitoring_agent
agents.description: Monitors cross-border velocity anomalies and stolen-card POS attempts using Memory Bank (`TRAVEL_STATUS`, `CARD_LIFECYCLE`), Dataplex Catalog (`catalog_discover_tables` & `catalog_authorize_table` to refuse `authorizations_deprecated_v1` and `cards.pan_full`), and BigQuery Golden Queries 03 & 04.

agents.name: telephony_ivr_agent
agents.description: Retrieves inbound call sessions and dropped-2FA recollections from Memory Bank (`AGENT_COMMITMENTS`, `CONTACT_PREFERENCE`) and verifies declined authorizations and call timestamps via BigQuery Golden Query 02 and `contact_history` under Dataplex governance.

agents.name: mobile_app_agent
agents.description: Inspects Apple Pay / Google Pay token states and mobile travel check-ins using Memory Bank (`DEVICE_WALLET_INVENTORY`, `TRAVEL_STATUS`), Dataplex Catalog, and BigQuery Golden Query 10 + `travel_notices`.

agents.name: web_portal_agent
agents.description: Reconciles online dispute claims (`DISPUTE_HISTORY`) against BigQuery Golden Queries 07, 08, 09 and resolves Regulation E (Debit) vs Regulation Z (Credit) rules from the Dataplex Business Glossary.

agents.name: branch_support_agent
agents.description: Handles in-person branch verification and standing instructions using Memory Bank (`CONTACT_PREFERENCE`, `AGENT_COMMITMENTS`), BigQuery Golden Query 01 (`v_customer_360`), and Dataplex column governance (`customers.ssn_last4` REFUSE).

agents.name: claim_veracity_validator_agent
agents.description: Validates customer claims against BigQuery ground truth (`disputed_amounts`, `travel_notices`) before Memory Bank write-back and audits agent adherence to Dataplex Catalog refusals.

agents.name: memory_bank_audit_agent
agents.description: Sweeps all stored customer memories in Vertex AI Memory Bank against BigQuery ground truth and Golden Query 11 (`dispute_event_timeline`), surfacing travel distractors and euro/dollar amount discrepancies.

agents.name: consumer_credit_synthesizer_agent
agents.description: Hub of the 8-agent mesh. Coordinates the 5 channel producer agents (01..05), the Pre-Write Veracity Validator (06), and the Memory Bank Auditor (07); enforces Dataplex Catalog governance & Glossary definitions; reconciles Memory Bank recollections against BigQuery ground truth; and drives zero-question resolution.
